name: ai-support-quality-gate
description: Deterministic Playwright release gate for an AI-assisted support summary workflow

scripts.test:evaluation: npm run build && tsx scripts/run-playwright.ts --suite=Evaluation tests/evaluation
scripts.test:api: npm run build && tsx scripts/run-playwright.ts --suite=API tests/api
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && tsx scripts/run-playwright.ts --suite=UI tests/ui
scripts.test:headed: npm run build && tsx scripts/run-playwright.ts --suite=UI --headed tests/ui
scripts.quality:check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
